basis: Lysosomal storage; ichthyosis and pancytopenia 80–99%, hepatic involvement with cholestasis 30–79%; contractures and ectropion omitted at four-axis cap.
Congenital absence of external ear and auditory canal with conductive hearing loss; secondary language delay does not establish neurologic damage.
Carcinoma arising in the ovary, a reproductive organ outside the axes; no other common direct organ involvement established.
Defined immunodeficiency; no additional common organ damage established across its subtypes.
GM2 storage causes progressive neurodegeneration; visual impairment occurs in 30–79%. Muscle wasting reflects denervation; aspiration pneumonia is a separate disease.
Familial common variable immunodeficiency with low immunoglobulins and recurrent infections; no additional common direct organ damage established.
Defining vertebral/rib defects and anal atresia; urinary malformations include urethral atresia and hydronephrosis. Pulmonary hypoplasia frequency is unestablished.
Carcinoma originates in the renal pelvis; no additional common direct organ involvement established.
Carcinoma arising from cutaneous epithelium; other organs are not commonly affected across this umbrella.
Cerebellar hypoplasia, ataxia and intellectual disability define disease; strabismus in 4/4. Flat feet alone do not establish damaging musculoskeletal involvement.
Hereditary choroidal dystrophy and atrophy, confined to the ocular axis.
Odontogenic epithelial neoplasm arising in the tooth-forming apparatus of the jaw, with occupation and destruction of jawbone.
Inborn glutamine metabolism disorders; neurologic dysfunction affects most patients across the principal subtypes, including brain dysgenesis, developmental impairment or ataxia.
Defined ocular growth disorder; brain and digit abnormalities are not established as common throughout this umbrella.
Developmental impairment and peripheral neuropathy; cardiac and renal malformations each 30–79%, strabismus 6/15. Constipation alone does not establish GI damage.
Childhood carcinoids arise predominantly in the appendix/GI tract; bronchial primaries are a minority. Neuroendocrine lineage alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Definition establishes salivary gland origin; resemblance to cutaneous basal cell carcinoma does not establish skin involvement.
CRYGS-related nonsyndromic cataract directly affects the lens; no extraocular disease established.
Intellectual disability and microcephaly define disease; sensorineural hearing impairment in 1/2 reported patients. Iris heterochromia does not establish ocular damage.
Dominant titinopathies encompass skeletal muscle disease and cardiomyopathy as major disease classes; respiratory failure is subtype-specific.
Segmental dermal cavernous vascular lesion occupies skin and abnormal blood vessels; vascular origin does not make it a blood-cell disease.
Congenital viral brain injury; macular scarring and retinal damage are major characteristic diagnostic features. Hearing loss and arthrogryposis affect a minority.
Defining enchondromas deform bone, with cutaneous/subcutaneous vascular tumors. Endocrine and CNS tumors are minority associated diseases.
Inherited platelet aggregation and coagulation defect; bleeding sites do not establish common direct damage to additional organs.
Tumor occupies the skin; Schwann-cell differentiation alone does not establish peripheral nerve damage.
